facts.text: The function depsChanged in worker-sensors.ts decides the dependency case by comparing package.json's dependency entries before and after the worker's change.
facts.hit: worker-sensors.ts uses depsChanged to detect dependency edits through a comparison of the original versus modified package.json dependency entries.

facts.text: The function testWeakening in worker-sensors.ts decides the weakened-tests case: fewer test cases or assertions, or new skip, only or todo markers, in a changed test file.
facts.hit: worker-sensors.ts uses testWeakening to flag modified tests with reduced case/assertion counts or additional skip/only/todo markers.

facts.text: runChecks in worker-sensors.ts turns each of the two decisions into a failure entry with a reason.
facts.hit: In worker-sensors.ts, runChecks records dependency-change or test-weakening decisions as failures carrying reasons.

facts.text: The verdict is the first line of the digest that scout returns, a line starting WORKER-SENSORS:.
facts.hit: scout places the verdict at the top of its returned digest under the WORKER-SENSORS: prefix.

decoys: scout --review BASE needs a clean working tree.
